sin.name: supervisor-service-verb
sin.description: The journal asks the supervisor to start or stop a service: the journal server is one of the supervisor's services and knows nothing of what the supervisor runs beside it.
sin.rule: Name the service in the launch file the launcher writes, so the supervisor starts, keeps alive and ends it; reach it through the server's service hooks, never by starting it from the journal. The plugin services and the tunnel are the named exceptions still to move.
